_meta.identityConfidenceReason: Confirmed via operator's own website (llangorse.com), Visit Wales listing, and TripAdvisor listing (g552062-d2103112) — all agree on name, location (The Gilfach, Llangorse, Brecon, Powys LD3 7UH), phone, and activity set.
redFlags: Seed data phone number (01874 658271) is wrong — correct number confirmed on 3 independent sources is 01874 658272.

Seed data claims kayaking, paddle-boarding, canoeing, and mountain biking as activities — none of these appear on the operator's own site, Visit Wales, or TripAdvisor. This appears to be fabricated/hallucinated content.
Seed data 'Zip Line Adventure' activity is misleading — the real offering is 'Sky Trek', a ~2km aerial zip line/ropes course, not a standalone zip-line-only product.

This operator ONLY serves the Brecon Beacons / Llangorse Lake area in Powys, Mid Wales. It has no presence in or connection to pembrokeshire, gower, anglesey, llyn-peninsula, or south-wales. Any combo pages in those five regions referencing this operator are factually wrong and must be fixed or the reference removed.

'mid-wales' as a combo-page region for this operator is defensible (Visit Wales itself files it under 'Mid Wales'), but on this site's regional taxonomy it should stay under brecon-beacons unless mid-wales is a distinct recognized region here — confirm against site's region list before publishing to mid-wales pages.

Google rating of 4.5 / 450 reviews in seed data is unverified and likely fabricated — TripAdvisor shows 147 reviews (112 Excellent, 18 Very Good, no aggregate star figure found); no Google Business rating could be sourced.

proposedOperatorData.name: Llangorse Multi Activity Centre
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Action-packed adventures in the Brecon Beacons, since 1958
proposedOperatorData.description:
Llangorse Multi Activity Centre is a family-run, multi-award-winning indoor and outdoor activity centre set on The Gilfach farm near Llangorse Lake in the Brecon Beacons National Park, Powys. Operating since 1958, it offers indoor climbing, bouldering, caving/potholing, abseiling and a high-wire course, alongside beginner-to-experienced horse riding and pony trekking across the Welsh countryside. Its signature outdoor attraction is Sky Trek, a roughly 2km aerial zip-line and ropes course through the estate.

The centre also runs archery, a junior challenge course, birthday parties, school trips/residentials, and corporate team-building days, with an on-site cafe (Base Camp). It is well established locally, ranked the top attraction in Llangorse on TripAdvisor with 147 reviews (112 rated Excellent, 18 Very Good). There is no evidence the centre offers water sports (kayaking, canoeing, paddle-boarding) or mountain biking, despite these appearing in some third-party listings.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: One of the longest-established multi-activity centres in the Brecon Beacons, combining indoor climbing/caving, horse riding, and a signature 2km Sky Trek aerial zip-line course on one site.
